{{Quote|The mere existence of a holopic featuring Lady Kalena in a servant girl outfit - while embarrassing to the Induparan elder houses - is cause for minor concern, but it hardly spells doom for the Empire.|[[Irnst Stavveld]], to [[Mirash Peet]]|<ref name="Pirates & Privateers">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>}}
[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Kalena''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]][[Gender/Legends|woman]] of [[House Indupar]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Kalena was traveling aboard the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Indupar Nova]]'' when the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was attacked by the [[Rebel privateer]] vessel ''[[Free Lance]]'' in the [[Ec Pand system/Legends|Ec Pand system]]. The [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] boarded the corvette and Kalena switched places with her lady-in-waiting, [[Missa]], in an attempt to deceive the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. However, the leader of the privateers, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Urias Xhaxin]], saw through the ruse, and he ordered Kalena and Missa to be held in comfort aboard the ''Free Lance''.
